assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The diagnosis codes are I25.10 and I34.0.
The symptoms are intermittent in nature.
There is a need to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances.
CPT 93271 (Cardiac Event Monitoring) is medically necessary to evaluate for potential arrhythmias.
The requested service is bundled into another covered procedure under Reason Code CO-97.
The appeal requests reconsideration of the medical necessity of CPT 93271 in the context of the patient's documented recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea.
